paragraphs: Rabbi Yose bar Bivi: end of Jerusalem Talmud, Megillah, and Shekalim, chapter 3: bar Bivin; in the Jerusalem Talmud the reading is bar Bun. Gamliel Zavvata questioned him. In Rav Huna’s name, there. In Shmuel’s name, there, chapter 5.
